content.text: Updating REST API to use premis:hasMessageDigest instead of fedora:digest
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/790
PR-790 looks good.
As a part of this ticket, please also remove "digest" from the "repository" ontology:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/ontology/blob/master/repository.rdf#L783
Andrew-
I've removed digest from the repository ontology:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/ontology/pull/26
Andrew-

Since we're changing the property that checksums are stored in (not just how they are exposed), and this is a server-managed property, we should provide a mechanism for migrating those values to the new property.
Perhaps this could be done on read requests, so repository managers would just need to retrieve the properties for every file?

The idea would be to have some logic that looks for the presence of the old property and writes it into the new property if the new property does not already exist? ...and potentially then removes the old property from the resource?
Andrew-

Yes, I would expect it to check for the old property and move it to the new property.  We should probably also do the same with mimetype and filename too.  I can post to the mailing list and check in with the Penn State folks about this to see what feedback we can get about this approach.
Since we are planning on a release (likely on Monday), maybe we should hold off on committing this current ticket and
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1532
until the server-side property-shifting logic is in place.
Thoughts?
I agree – we should have this sorted about before the new property usage is in a release.
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/790
PR-790 has been merged.
The fixity service uses premis:hasMessageDigest for file checksums, but the file description uses fedora:digest.  We should use the same property in both places.
